Marcus Johnson  
Senior QA Test Engineer | Lumina Games  
Email: marcus.johnson@lumina.games | Phone: +44 7700 900123 | Location: London, UK | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/marcusjohnsonqa  

**Professional Summary**  
A seasoned QA Test Engineer with 5 years of experience in delivering high-quality, scalable testing solutions for AAA game development. Specialized in API and performance testing, with a proven track record of designing automation frameworks that reduce regression cycles by 30% and improve test coverage. Proactive in integrating CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous validation of game tools and multiplayer server logic. Fluent in English and German, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration across development, design, and operations teams.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior QA Test Engineer* | Lumina Games (2022–Present)  
- Led API testing for multiplayer game servers, ensuring seamless communication between client and backend systems.  
- Integrated JMeter to validate performance under peak user loads, identifying bottlenecks that reduced latency by 25% in live environments.  
- Collaborated with DevOps to automate deployment validation, cutting manual regression testing time by 40% in three major releases.  
- Designed REST API test suites for in-game economy systems, ensuring compliance with security and data integrity standards.  

*QA Engineer* | Vortex Studios (2020–2022)  
- Developed Selenium-based test automation for web-based game tools, achieving 95% coverage of core user workflows.  
- Contributed to test strategy design for cross-platform game launch, aligning with agile sprints and sprint retrospectives.  
- Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, enabling automated test execution on every code push and reducing environment setup time by 50%.  
- Conducted integration testing for multiplayer matchmaking systems, resolving critical race conditions that improved match stability by 35%.  

*QA Tester* | Nova Interactive (2018–2020)  
- Executed manual testing for mobile games, logging over 500 test cases across iOS and Android platforms.  
- Automated basic test scripts in Python to validate core game mechanics, reducing repetitive test cycles by 20%.  
- Collaborated with developers to prioritize bug fixes, ensuring critical issues were resolved within 24 hours of reporting.  

**Education**  
*Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering* | University of Southern California (2015–2019)  
- Thesis: "Automated Test Frameworks for Real-Time Systems" (focused on game server validation).  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Python**: Owned the development of a custom test framework for in-game event systems, reducing manual testing hours by 60%.  
- **API Testing**: Designed and executed test cases for RESTful endpoints in multiplayer game servers, ensuring compliance with SLAs.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Integrated GitLab CI to automate test execution, improving release reliability by 30%.  
- **Go**: Utilized Go for building lightweight test utilities to validate game server protocols, reducing setup complexity.  
- **Integration Testing**: Validated cross-component interactions in game engines, resolving 12 critical issues in pre-launch phases.  
- **Performance Testing (JMeter/k6)**: Conducted stress tests on server infrastructure, identifying scalability limits before live deployments.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Automated web-based game tool validations, achieving 90% coverage of user-facing features.  
- **Test Automation**: Spearheaded the transition from manual to automated testing, increasing test efficiency by 50%.  
- **Unit Testing**: Developed unit tests for core game logic, reducing defect leakage to downstream systems by 45%.  

**Languages**  
- English (near-native)  
- German (professional working proficiency)
